email.subject: Application for AI Engineer
email.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I would like to apply for the AI Engineer position. My CV is too large to attach, so you can download it here:
https://files.example.com/cv/junaid-akram-cv.pdf

Regards,
Junaid Akram

why: A real applicant who sends the CV only as a link, with no file. It must go on the "could not read" list. Open point: as the product flow is written, the mail search lists only emails with a PDF or Word attachment and would never see this one (decisions.md, tasks 22 and 27).
